scope.resume_cursor_semantics: to be verified from pinned runner and checkpoint; no index convention assumed before inspection
scope.resume_initialization_ceiling: one nearest authenticated checkpoint, at most 37 unique source-hour partitions to reach and cross cursor 2340, and no more than one post-boundary partition; stop if valid initialization requires wider history
scope.feature_opened_utc_rule: market_start_utc minus 120 seconds; verify against frozen E0041/E0048 contract
scope.holdout_data_use: technical source/feature causality only in the exact E0048 interval; no targets, labels, resolutions, predictions, economics, or evaluator

sources_and_code.repository_code_identity: commit 869efc4 on the recorded branch; exact control scripts/configs will be hashed before each run

comparison_criteria.e0037: trace source -> parser -> reducer -> checkpoint/snapshot -> checker; exact market/token/side, event/receive timestamps, T-60/T-59 inclusion, ask/bid, price/size and BBO fields; preserve E0037 and E0036 saved artifacts; no reference-value substitution
comparison_criteria.resume: same authenticated state/config/source and fragments; exact semantic equality at cursor and after continuation for all active books, counters, cursor/order, freshness/history buffers, T-60/T-59 snapshots and deterministic products; metadata-only exclusions declared before comparison; no numerical tolerance
comparison_criteria.features: same frozen state and feature pipeline on contract-truncated prefix versus full source for the five preselected technical anchors; exact ordered 102 feature columns and exact values including NaN masks; future suffix changes must not change prior rows; no fit or model invocation
comparison_criteria.performance: measure only the selected correctness workloads with monotonic wall time, CPU, read bytes, rows/events, peak RSS, checkpoint bytes and exit code; no benchmark matrix

stop_conditions: no full 2377-hour replay or full E0048 benchmark
stop resume replay if the shortest valid initialization exceeds the frozen 37-partition ceiling or requires an empty in-stream book
do not replace missing authentic historical checkpoint evidence with a synthetic checkpoint; report the distinction
no source-window, sample, count, tolerance, feature, cutoff, or acceptance-threshold changes
no background watcher; every diagnostic process is bounded, logged, and its exit code recorded
preserve all recovered inputs/checkpoints and all prior E0037/E0048 history
